title: Vael's Proposal

narrative.text: Lucan Vael's private study is a monument to wealth — Veltrian oak, Arcturian crystal, Orythian silk. He does not invite you. He requests your presence, which is different. Vostane is already there, seated in a leather chair, her expression professionally neutral. Vael stands by the window.

Chancellor. Your free-market direction has impressed certain parties — parties with capital, connections, and an interest in a stable, prosperous Veltria. I am prepared to facilitate a significant investment package. Arcturian technology firms want access to Veltrian heavy industry. Orythian banks want to finance our infrastructure. I can make introductions. In exchange, I ask only that my consortium be given first consideration for state contracts. A partnership, not a purchase.

The numbers are good. Vael's consortium would bring approximately 80 million VK in foreign investment within the first year. The infrastructure modernization would accelerate by eighteen months. The cost — first consideration on state contracts — is standard practice in most developing economies. I recommend acceptance with appropriate oversight.

monologue: Eighty million in foreign investment. Infrastructure acceleration by eighteen months. The cost: first consideration on state contracts. Vostane calls it standard practice. She is correct. Standard practice is what the Halvek era called it too. The difference between a partnership and a quiet purchase is the oversight framework — and oversight frameworks only work when the overseer cannot be fired.

choices.text: "I will work with your consortium, Vael. But I want the oversight framework in writing — competitive bidding after the first round, transparency on all contracts, and veto authority if terms become unfavorable. You want partnership? This is partnership."

reactions.text: He extends his hand. You want partnership, he repeats. Then he nods — the nod of a man who has gotten most of what he wanted. He will remember the oversight clauses. He will try to work around them.
She writes oversight framework on her pad and underlines it. She will enforce the terms. Vostane enforces everything she writes down.

choices.text: "I appreciate the offer, Vael. But I did not open Veltria's markets to replace government monopoly with oligarch monopoly. The competitive bidding process will be open to all — including your consortium. You will compete like everyone else."

reactions.text: He sets down his glass. The motion is very precise — the precision of a man who has just been told no and is already calculating his next approach.
